setup_train_net: setup detectron2 config by merging centernet and vldet configs from a yaml file and command line opts
train_vldet_model: train a vldet detection model with custom optimizer, lr scheduler, and periodic checkpointing on distributed GPUs
test_vldet_model: test a vldet model on COCO, LVIS, or OpenImages datasets with custom evaluators and inference
launch_distributed_training: launch distributed training with argument parser, TCP URL setup, and detectron2 launch for multi-GPU execution
resume_or_load_model: resume or load a vldet model checkpoint with detection checkpointer and continue training from saved iteration
